label: Inference
claim: The local drawing-card run contains 48,129 extracted rows; 19,157 have parseable dot-segment position codes, and 5,139 rows have at least one direct child under the implementation's same-file/same-sheet context. The implementation therefore currently excludes a non-trivial structural-parent subset before classification.

details.method: Local-only structural recount using the current exact-dot parser and file/sheet context; no raw cell values retained.

label: Inference
claim: Direct-child structure alone is not a safe aggregate signal in this run: among 5,139 structural-parent rows, 1,144 reconcile to the sum of direct-child remaining costs, 3,960 do not reconcile, and 35 lack a comparable cost. The artifact records 3,958 cost-mismatch issues, 92 duplicate-position issues, and 21 position-gap issues.

details.method: Local-only direct-child remaining-cost comparison using the existing tolerance; reconciliation is a screening signal, not financial confirmation.

label: Inference
claim: A narrower candidate family is strongly concentrated: 1,141 of the 1,144 cost-reconciled structural parents have neither a unit nor a remaining quantity, while only 3 have both. Conversely, 1,164 non-reconciled structural parents have both a unit and a remaining quantity. This supports a fail-closed candidate rule that requires direct children, absent parent unit/quantity, and cost reconciliation; it does not support auto-confirming the candidate as an aggregate.

details.method: Local-only field-presence and direct-child-cost cross-tab; work-name content was not retained in this evidence.

label: Inference
claim: The run has three distinct anonymous sheet archetypes, not one uniform hierarchy: their parseable-position/structural-parent counts are 13,502/1,769, 3,464/3,241, and 2,191/129. The middle archetype has zero reconciled parents, whereas the other two have 1,025 and 119 reconciled parents. Filtering every parent would therefore disproportionately remove rows from an archetype with no reconciliation evidence.

details.method: Local-only aggregation by private file/sheet context; identifiers deliberately replaced with bounded archetype labels.

label: Inference
claim: The tested hierarchy contract recognizes only exact dot-segment ancestry within an explicit context, preserves leaves in source order, and emits integrity issues rather than dropping leaves for mismatches. The drawing-card workflow, however, treats every structural parent as excluded before matching. Safe implementation should keep exact parsing and context isolation but move from unconditional exclusion to candidate tagging plus review/explicit policy, retaining standalone work and resource-detail rows by default.

details.method: Source-and-test contract inspection; recommendation is a safety inference, not a production change.
